reviews.text: Very bad experience with the front desk. Doctor itself was good, but front lady left overall very bad experience on the 15th.
Pleasant, professional veterinarian.

It was Nila’s first ever visit to the vet, and we couldn’t have wished for a better experience! She was treated so sweetly and with so much care. We were also treated with great professionalism and received all the right information and advice.

The lady at the reception was also incredibly kind and welcoming to us as well. Overall, we felt very comfortable and well taken care of.

This veterinarian provides misleading information about cat behavior (possibly out of self-interest). Additionally, the practice forgot to issue a European pet passport for our cat, or even to mention that the cat does not have one yet. Which is very sloppy and unprofessional! This caused a huge amount of hassle when we suddenly had to go to another veterinarian for an emergency operation.
Received expert assistance. It is difficult if you don't speak English.
Very skilled vets who understands that a pet is part of the family
Very customer-friendly and helpful
Knowledgeable, understanding and above all animal-friendly staff.

We received excellent care at this clinic when our cat hadn't eaten for several days. Very friendly doctors and assistants, and a lovely place. Good explanations and guidance. I'm glad I switched vets!

I came to this clinic last year after moving to the neighborhood, as my dog was suffering from persistent coughing. He was immediately put on a strong steroid (prednisone), without proper explanation of the potential long-term or harmful side effects.

I have always done my dog’s more serious diagnostic testing at Evidensia, which I continued to do. Through those tests, it was discovered that my dog had lungworms. Something that this clinic never checked. They kept flip flopping between a diagnostic of asthma or chronic bronchitis.
Despite this, he remained on the medication prescribed by this clinic.
Getting medication from this clinic was consistently frustrating. I would agree on a price with the receptionist, return the next day to collect it, and the price would suddenly change. This happened more than five times.

Although I never fully trusted this clinic, I stayed with them for emergencies because my dog is very old and this is the closest practice to my home.

Today, I went in to discuss how we could safely take my dog off this medication. Instead of medical guidance, I was met with a confrontational and dismissive attitude. The doctor stated that I “spend all my money at Evidensia” and implied that I should not expect advice because I chose to do testing elsewhere.
She dismissed Evidensia’s lungworm diagnosis outright and criticised the latest antibiotic prescription, calling it “strange.”

She also refused to review recent tests done within the last few months and insisted that everything be repeated at her clinic, including an ultrasound that had already been done. When I questioned this, she claimed she “only cares about my dog” and that this was why all testing should be done there.

Every interaction at this clinic costs €70 for a consultation that lasts about 10 minutes and provides no new or useful information. The overall attitude felt focused on money rather than my dog’s wellbeing.

Today, I spent my last money at this clinic, and I deeply regret it. The lack of professionalism, respect, and genuine care has cost me time, money, and potentially my dog’s health.
Disgusting experience. I would not recommend this clinic to anyone. If you want a place where your pet’s suffering comes second to billing, this is it.

For months, we were sent from pillar to post with our dog. Medication (prednisone) was prescribed without the serious side effects or the risks of abruptly stopping it being clearly explained.

The diagnosis (chronic bronchitis) turned out to be incorrect and merely a possibility. A second opinion at an animal hospital revealed that our dog had lungworms. This is a completely different condition and could and should have been detected earlier.

What makes it particularly distressing is the way my partner was treated during our last visit. She was spoken to in an unprofessional and unfriendly tone, visibly incomprehensible and irritated by the fact that we had requested a second opinion and sought care elsewhere. They even suggested that this was "costing them money."

Surprisingly, the tone is correct when I'm present or on the phone and speak Dutch. This feels extremely unpleasant and disrespectful.

Our dog is 14 years old and has multiple health problems. It seems perfectly normal to me that we're asking questions and being concerned. Unfortunately, we had a strong feeling that financial interests outweighed our dog's well-being.
Thanks for your help. ♥️🤗 …

Good vet!

I have been coming to this practice for at least 40 years. Now the practice has changed completely (2025).
It is nowhere near the nice feeling there used to be at the Overtoom.
That 'everyone knows everyone' feeling? At the Overtoom you could drop off your dog and happily stay there for an anesthetic treatment (super nice for dog and owner). And you were called before the dog came out of anesthesia; how amazing was that for dog and owner?

Fortunately, I haven't experienced any emergencies with my new dog yet.
But the feeling upon entering was already so different and impersonal compared to the warm welcome at the Overtoom.
Friendly staff ! professional doctors ! My cats loves the clinic 🐈 🐈 …
Nice, kind people who think carefully about the best care for our dog. Combination of diet and medication.
Very kind people to Miso and Toos
Professional, great service and took good loving care of my cat!

Quite negative.

Lady behind the counter not very dog-friendly🤭
A bit of a weird treatment or guidance when the dog had to go under anesthesia…

And after asking if they might be able to remove some tangles from the Springer Spaniel's tail while he was asleep🤭🫣😳
Sloppily short-clipped tail, poor dog (and owner)
Not very professional or helpful…

Lovely experience - needed a simple deworming tablet to take dog back to UK. Practice squeezed us in to an appointment on the day and no hassle when we were late due to traffic jams. Thorough examination included from a caring vet.  Helpful reception team.
Nice people, personal attention. I was also able to get an appointment very quickly with my cat. 👍 …
Wonderful and polite veterinarians Natalia and Melody helped my bulldog get treatment for allergies and get a certificate for a flight to Poland.
Helped me out when I couldn’t go to my own vet with a very sick cat. Quick diagnose and a very kind follow up call after the weekend
Had telephone contact and was helped very well

I just had my cat Misty put to sleep.
I was treated with the utmost respect and am very satisfied with Misty's care.
If I ever get another cat, I will definitely come back.
High praise for Dierenpraktijk Overtoom.

The practice has been the vet for our two cats for over 6 years.  Their new location is very clean, bright and professional, and we have been very happy with their treatment for our girls (one 17 yo blind & deaf and one 3 yo Siamese).   Highly recommend.
Very professional and friendly. Nice new location on the Overtoom.

Thank you again this time for the excellent care of my cat, who is now 18.5 years old. I came to this vet over 10 years ago on the recommendation of a friend. They take the time for you and provide the right care. That is the best thing you could wish for if you love your pet!

Our pets have been going to these vets for years. One of our cats has been in the clinic a lot in recent weeks. Very dedicated, caring vets who are very helpful and even called to check on her progress. Grateful for all the excellent care ❤

I live on the Overtoom and have been coming to this clinic for years, it is truly unworthy of animals and people, if they can make money they help, if they can save lives and help animals they are not interested, they would rather be home on time than give animals in pain relief. I am really very sad that this company has no heart, just a cash register.
Dear people. We are very happy to help and are still participating with the city pass. Few clinics still put effort into this.
